create_locally_linear_embedding: create a Locally Linear Embedding of high-dimensional data into a lower-dimensional space
build_LocallyLinearEmbedding_transformer: build a LocallyLinearEmbedding transformer to reduce dimensionality using locally linear embedding
compute_barycenter_weights: compute barycenter weights of data points from their nearest neighbors for LLE reconstruction
build_barycenter_kneighbors_graph: build a barycenter-weighted k-neighbors graph for locally linear embedding
find_null_space_eigenvectors: find the null space eigenvectors of a covariance matrix using ARPACK or dense eigen-solvers
